RelaxValley.Config.OpenMenu.Name: Open Main Menu
RelaxValley.Config.OpenMenu.Tooltip: Press this key to open the Relax Valley main menu (default F3).
RelaxValley.Config.ShopProgress.Name: Shop Progress Mode
RelaxValley.Config.ShopProgress.Tooltip:
On: remote shops unlock after opening them once in-game.
Off: all installed shops are always available (opening hours still apply).
RelaxValley.Config.FriendshipProgress.To:
On: unmet villagers can't be interacted with.
Off: you can meet new villagers directly (one-click talk and card clicks both work).
RelaxValley.Config.ElevatorProgress.Name: Elevator Progress Mode
RelaxValley.Config.ElevatorProgress.Tool:
On: elevator floors unlock by the deepest level reached.
Off: all mine and Skull Cavern floors are available.
RelaxValley.Config.TalkAll.Name: Talk to Everyone
RelaxValley.Config.TalkAll.Tooltip:
Show the "Talk to Everyone" button on the friendship page.
Disabled by default.
RelaxValley.Config.FriendshipTeleport.To:
Show the "Warp" option in the villager card interaction menu.
Disabled by default.
RelaxValley.Config.BatchGift.Name: Gift Everyone
RelaxValley.Config.BatchGift.Tooltip:
Show the "Gift Everyone" button on the friendship page: gives one of the held item to each villager who hasn't received a gift today, using vanilla gift rules.
Consumes gift opportunities, disabled by default.
RelaxValley.Config.VanillaGates.Name: Respect Vanilla Gates
RelaxValley.Config.VanillaGates.Tooltip:
On: Casino Stats requires the rusty key and Qi's Orders requires the Walnut Room to be open (same as vanilla entry conditions).
Off: both are always available.
On by default.
RelaxValley.Config.FishingGrayUncaught.T:
On: fish you haven't caught yet appear gray on the fishing info page (info stays visible); they turn normal once caught.
On by default.
RelaxValley.Config.AnimalPetAll.Name: Pet Everyone
RelaxValley.Config.AnimalPetAll.Tooltip:
Show the "Pet Everyone" button on the farm animals page: pets every animal that hasn't been petted today.
Disabled by default.
RelaxValley.Config.AnimalHarvestNoTool.T:
The "Harvest" option on the farm animals page no longer requires holding the matching tool (milk pail / shears).
Disabled by default (vanilla behavior).
RelaxValley.Config.StatsMenuTypes.Name: External Animal Page (Menu Types)
RelaxValley.Config.StatsMenuTypes.Toolti:
Full type names to instantiate when right-clicking "Farm Animals", separated by semicolons.
Format: Namespace.TypeName, AssemblyName.
